sourceText.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמְבַכֶּרֶת, הַמְקַשָּׁה לֵילֵד – מְחַתֵּךְ אֵבֶר אֵבֶר, וּמַשְׁלִיךְ לִכְלָבִים. יָצָא רוּבּוֹ – הֲרֵי זֶה יִקָּבֵר, וְנִפְטֶרֶת מִן הַבְּכוֹרָה.

positions.claim: before most of the fetus has emerged it is not consecrated, so its limbs may be cut off and thrown to the dogs; once most of it has emerged it must be buried and the mother is exempt from firstborn status thereafter
